ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into the financial trail of Medicaid fraud, including the Feeding Our Future scheme.
questions: How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What steps are being taken to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant financial losses and shed light on the need for increased oversight and accountability in the Medicaid program.
